title: Feraboli Zootech
description: feraboli.it Feraboli Zootech is a historic Italian company operating in the livestock sector since 1880, with a heritage spanning over six generations. Based in Sospiro (Cremona), it specializes in designing and building advanced cattle barns, metal structures, and tailor-made equipment for dairy and fattening farms. The company combines traditional craftsmanship with modern automation and animal welfare solutions for professional breeders.
